name: Training compute of notable AI models
what_it_measures: Estimated total floating-point operations (FLOP) used to train each model. Each estimate carries Epoch's confidence label: Confident, Likely or Speculative.
source: Epoch AI, Data on AI Models
licence_note: Epoch's README: the data is free to use, distribute, and reproduce provided the source and authors are credited.
citation: Epoch AI, 'Data on AI Models'. Published online at epoch.ai. Retrieved from https://epoch.ai/data/ai-models
changes: From notable_ai_models.csv: every model with a publication date kept, with or without an estimate; 10 of its columns kept and renamed; FLOP rounded to 4 significant figures; 'Open model weights?' turned into true, false or blank. Coverage notes, trend lines and summaries (summary.json) are ours.

coverage.summary: 1,072 models Epoch judges 'notable', 1950 to 2026-09-21. A compute estimate exists for 540 of them. In the last 12 months (2025-09-21 to 2026-09-21) it exists for 30 of 120. Labs that publish details are counted more often than labs that don't, so the newest part of any compute curve leans on whoever discloses.
coverage.counted: Models Epoch lists as notable (state of the art, highly cited, historically important, or widely used), with an estimate built from papers, announcements and hardware reports.
coverage.not_counted: Models with no public details. In the last 12 months: OpenAI 1 of 24; Alibaba 1 of 12; Google DeepMind 1 of 11; Anthropic 0 of 10; Meta AI 0 of 4; xAI 0 of 4; Character.ai 0 of 3; MiniMax 0 of 3.
